{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
import socket,re,sys
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(0)
s=socket.create_connection(('172.19.0.2',21200),timeout=10); f=s.makefile('rwb',buffering=0)
line=f.readline(); print('prompt:',line.decode(errors='replace').rstrip())
b=int(re.search(rb'base (\d+)',line).group(1))
d={0:b-4,1:2,2:1,b-4:1}
# checker index k gets the digit at base-b power b**(b-1-k)
r=sum(v*pow(b,b-1-k) for k,v in d.items())
# independently reconstruct exactly as check() does
x=r; got=[0]*b
for i in range(b): got[b-i-1]=x%b; x//=b
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter(got)
assert x==0 and all(got[i]==cnt[i] for i in range(b)), (b,[(i,got[i],cnt[i]) for i in range(b) if got[i]!=cnt[i]][:5])
a=str(r).encode()+b'\n'; print(f'b={b}, validated locally, sending {len(a)-1} decimal digits'); f.write(a)
print(f.read().decode(errors='replace'))
PY", "timeout_seconds": 30}
